Errors.COURSE_NOT_FOUND: This Course no longer exists in the Catalog. Reload the page to refresh the list.
Errors.ENROLLMENT_NOT_FOUND: This Enrollment has already ended. Reload the page to see the current list.
Errors.USER_ALREADY_EXISTS_USE_ANOTHER_EMAIL: Another Account already uses this email.
Errors.ADMIN_UPDATE_FIELD_NOT_ALLOWED: That field cannot be changed from here.

Errors.INSTITUTION_ID_TAKEN: Another Institution already uses this id. Choose a different id.
Errors.MAJOR_ID_TAKEN: Another Major already uses this id. Choose a different id.

Errors.INSTITUTION_NOT_FOUND: This Institution no longer exists. Reload the page to refresh the list.
Errors.MAJOR_NOT_FOUND: This Major no longer exists. Reload the page to refresh the list.
Errors.SLUG_TAKEN: Another active Course already uses this slug. Choose a different slug.
Errors.PUBLISH_PRECONDITION: A publishing rule blocks this change, so nothing was changed.
Errors.COURSE_IN_USE: This Course has Enrollments, Sessions or Content versions that were live or uploaded, so it cannot be deleted. Archive it instead.
Errors.CHAPTER_NUMBER_TAKEN: Another Coming soon or Published Chapter of this Course already has this number. Choose a free number, or reorder the Chapters.

Errors.CHAPTER_IN_USE: This Chapter has study Sessions, or Content versions that were live or uploaded, so it cannot be deleted. Archive it instead.

Errors.UPLOAD_TOKEN_REQUIRED: The upload could not start because no upload token was sent. Try the upload again.
Errors.UPLOAD_TOKEN_INVALID: The upload token was not recognised. Try the upload again.
Errors.UPLOAD_TOKEN_USED: That upload token was already used. Try the upload again.
Errors.UPLOAD_TOKEN_EXPIRED: The upload token expired before the upload started. Try the upload again.
Errors.PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE: The upload is larger than the server accepts. Leave out files that are not content and try again.
Errors.UNSUPPORTED_UPLOAD_TYPE: The server only takes a zip file. Choose a zip file or a folder.
Errors.EMPTY_UPLOAD: The upload was empty. Choose a folder or a zip file with files in it.
Errors.INVALID_ARCHIVE: This is not a readable zip file, or it holds the same path twice. Check it and try again.
Errors.EMPTY_ARCHIVE: The zip file holds no files.
Errors.UNSAFE_ARCHIVE_PATH: The zip holds a file path that is not allowed, such as one that climbs out of its folder. Rename or remove it.
Errors.TOO_MANY_ENTRIES: The zip holds too many files. Leave out files that are not content.
Errors.ARCHIVE_TOO_LARGE: The files in the zip are too large once unpacked. Leave out files that are not content.
Errors.CONTENT_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: Content storage is not set up on the server, so nothing can be uploaded or deleted. Ask whoever runs the backend.
Errors.CONTENT_STORAGE_FAILED: Content storage refused the change, so nothing was changed. Try again in a moment.
Errors.VERSION_INVALID: That version failed validation, so it cannot go live. Fix the files and upload a new version.
Errors.VERSION_IN_USE: This version is or was live, or a Session used it, so it cannot be deleted. Keep it, or set another version live.
Errors.CONTENT_VERSION_NOT_FOUND: This version no longer exists. Reload the page to refresh the list.
Errors.FOLDER_UNREADABLE: The folder could not be read or zipped. Try again, or zip it yourself and upload the zip.

email.title: Email
email.description: The address this Student signs in with and receives emails at.
email.sameEmail: This is already the current email.
email.changeDescription: {email} replaces the current address. It becomes unverified and a verification email is sent to it. The Student must open that link to verify it.
email.changed: Email changed. A verification email was sent to {email}.
email.markVerifiedHelp: Use this when you have confirmed the address yourself. No email is sent.

password.title: Password
password.description: Send the Student a link to choose a new password. Admins never see or set passwords.
password.dialogDescription: {email} receives a link to choose a new password. Their current password keeps working until they use it.

actions.title: Actions
actions.selfNote: This is your own Account. You cannot ban, change the Role of or remove it.
actions.freshRequired: After you sign in again, you come back to this Account.
actions.removed: Account removed. Going back to the Accounts list.

ban.title: Ban
ban.description: A banned Account cannot sign in, and its Device sessions end at once.
ban.never: The ban does not end on its own.
ban.expiredAt: The ban ended <time>{date}</time>. It lifts when the Student next tries to sign in, or you can lift it now.
ban.dialogDescription: The Student cannot sign in while banned, and every Device session ends now.
ban.reasonHelp: Only Admins see it. It is kept in the Audit log.
ban.customDaysInvalid: Enter a whole number of days from 1 to 3650.
ban.done: Account banned. Its Device sessions ended.

devices.title: Device sessions
devices.description: Where this Account is signed in. Revoking a Device session signs that device out.
devices.empty: No Device sessions. This Account is not signed in anywhere.
devices.revokeAllDescription: Every device this Account is signed in on is signed out. The Student can sign in again.
devices.selfNote: Revoking all is off for your own Account, because it would sign you out. Manage your own devices on My account.

role.title: Role
role.description: Students study. Admins also manage Accounts, the Catalog and Course content.
role.promoteDescription: An Admin can ban and remove Accounts, edit the Catalog and Courses, read the Audit log and study without a time limit. The new Admin must also turn on two-factor before any of these work.
role.demoteDescription: The Account loses every Admin power at once, including access to this dashboard. It keeps its Enrollments and Plan.
role.promoted: Role changed. This Account is now an Admin.
role.demoted: Role changed. This Account is now a Student.

remove.title: Remove Account
remove.dialogDescription: This erases the Account, its Enrollments, its Sessions and its Plan assignment. It cannot be undone. The Audit log keeps only the Account's id. Langfuse traces of past Sessions remain.

form.idReadOnly: The id was set when this was created and cannot be changed.

dialog.institutionLocked: Accounts hold this Major, so it cannot move to another Institution.
dialog.idHelp: Lowercase letters, digits, "-" and "_". Suggested from the Institution and the English name.

form.slugEditHelp: Used in Student links. Changing it changes those links: the old Course page stops resolving, and session links with the old slug redirect to the new one.
form.codeHelp: The short code Students know the Course by, like CS101. Up to 40 characters.
form.look: The icon and tone decide how the Student app draws the Course card.

dialog.createDescription: A new Course is a Draft: Students cannot see it until you publish it. Every field can be changed later, including the slug.
dialog.noInstitutions: There are no Institutions to choose from. Add an Institution first.
dialog.institutionsFailed: The Institutions could not be loaded, so a Course cannot be added now. Reload the page to try again.

CourseDetail.title: Course
CourseDetail.notFoundDescription: This Course does not exist, or it was deleted.
CourseDetail.errorTitle: The Course could not be loaded

header.idHelp: Fixed for the life of the Course. The slug can change; this cannot.

details.title: Details
details.description: Names, code, slug, Institution and how the Course card looks. Only the fields you change are saved.
details.institutionsFailed: The Institution list could not be loaded, so the Institution cannot be changed now.
details.slugDialogDescription: Student links to this Course use the slug. After this change the Course page at the old slug stops resolving, while session links that still carry the old slug redirect to the new one. Share the new links.

status.title: Status
status.description: Draft Courses are hidden from Students. Published Courses are visible in the Catalog. Archived Courses are hidden and take no new Enrollments, and the existing Enrollments continue.
status.blockedPublishedChapters: Not available while the Course has a Published Chapter. Move its Chapters out of Published first, or archive the Course.

draft.title: Move this Course back to Draft?
draft.description: The Course is hidden from the Student Catalog and Students cannot enroll in it. Only Admins see it.

published.title: Publish this Course?
published.description: The Course becomes visible in the Student Catalog and Students can enroll in it. Students see its Coming soon and Published Chapters.

archived.title: Archive this Course?
archived.description: The Course is hidden from the Student Catalog and takes no new Enrollments. Students who are already enrolled keep their Enrollment and can keep studying.

status.leavesArchived: The slug counts as unique again once the Course leaves Archived. If another active Course already uses it, this is refused and you can change the slug first.
status.preconditionHelp: A Course cannot go back to Draft while it has a Published Chapter, because Students could lose a Chapter they can start. Move the Chapters out of Published first, or archive the Course.
status.slugTakenHelp: Change this Course's slug in Details, or archive the other Course that uses it, then try again.

delete.title: Delete Course
delete.description: Permanently deletes this Course and its Chapters. This cannot be undone.
delete.dialogDescription: This permanently deletes the Course and all its Chapters. It cannot be undone.

blockers.contentVersions: Content versions that were live or uploaded

delete.blockedArchive: Archive it instead. It is then hidden from the Catalog and takes no new Enrollments, and everything that exists stays.
delete.blockedArchived: It is already archived, which is the right place for it.

chapters.title: Chapters
chapters.description: Coming soon and Published Chapters are numbered and listed to Students in that order. Drafts and Archived Chapters are hidden from Students.
chapters.loadFailed: The Chapters could not be loaded
chapters.empty: This Course has no Chapters yet. Add a Draft, upload its content, then publish it.

groups.numberedEmpty: No Coming soon or Published Chapters. Move a Draft here when it is ready.

row.deleteBlocked: Cannot be deleted: {reason} Archive it instead.

deleteBlockers.contentVersions: it has Content versions that were live or uploaded.

order.instructions: To reorder, press Space or Enter on the handle, move with the arrow keys, then press Space or Enter again to drop. Press Escape to cancel. The Move up and Move down actions do the same.
order.changed: The order has changed. Save it to renumber the Chapters from 1 in this order.
order.locked: Save or reset the new order before changing a Chapter.

dialog.createDescription: It is created as a Draft, hidden from Students. Upload its content, then move it to Coming soon or Published.
dialog.editDescription: Only the fields you change are saved. To change the state, use the Chapter's actions menu.

form.minutesHelp: How long the Chapter takes, a whole number from 1 to 1,000.
form.lessonCountHelp: How many lessons it has. Content uploads can set this too.
form.numberHelpCreate: Leave blank to use the next free number, {next}. A Draft may share a number with a Coming soon or Published Chapter.
form.numberHelpLive: Must not be used by another Coming soon or Published Chapter. To move a Chapter among the others, drag it instead.
form.numberHelpOther: Only has to be free when the Chapter goes Coming soon or Published.
form.lessonCountFromContent: Set by the live Chapter content version, so it cannot be edited here. Set another version live to change it.

state.leavesNumbered: Its number is freed. The other Chapters keep their numbers until you save the order.
state.joinsNumbered: It takes number {number} in the Coming soon and Published list.

blockers.numberTaken: Another Coming soon or Published Chapter already has number {number}. Change this Chapter's number first, in Edit details.
blockers.chapterContent: This Chapter has no live Chapter content version. Upload one and set it live first.
blockers.courseContent: The Course has no live Course content version. Upload one and set it live first.

state.preconditionStale: A live content version changed since this page loaded. Reload the page to see the current state.
state.numberTakenHelp: Change the number in Edit details, or reorder the Chapters, then try again.

draft.title: Move this Chapter back to Draft?
draft.description: Students no longer see the Chapter and cannot start it. Its content and study history stay.

coming_soon.title: Mark this Chapter as Coming soon?
coming_soon.description: Students see the Chapter in the Course's list with its number, but cannot start it. It needs no content.

published.title: Publish this Chapter?
published.description: Students can start this Chapter. It teaches from its live Chapter content version and the Course's live Course content version.

archived.title: Archive this Chapter?
archived.description: The Chapter is hidden from Students and cannot be started. Its content, numbers and study history stay, and it can come back as a Draft.

replace.title: Replace this Chapter with a Draft
replace.description: Pick one of the Course's Drafts. In one step, the Draft takes this Chapter's number and state, and this Chapter is archived.
replace.none: This Course has no Drafts. Add a Draft Chapter and give it live content, then come back.

blockers.courseContent: The Course has no live Course content version.

replace.summary: <name>{draft}</name> takes number {number} and becomes {state}. <name>{old}</name> is archived.
replace.preconditionHelp: Replacing a Published Chapter needs the Draft to have a live Chapter content version, and the Course a live Course content version. Set them live, then try again.
replace.invalidHelp: Reload the page to see the Chapters as they are now.

delete.title: Delete this Chapter?
delete.description: This permanently deletes {title}. It cannot be undone. The other Chapters keep their numbers, and saving the order closes the gap.

ChapterDetail.title: Chapter
ChapterDetail.notFoundDescription: This Chapter does not exist, or it was deleted.
ChapterDetail.errorTitle: The Chapter could not be loaded

header.contentLive: Has a live Chapter content version
header.idHelp: Fixed for the life of the Chapter.

chapter.title: Content versions
chapter.description: Every upload of this Chapter's files is kept as a numbered version. New Sessions use the live version; Sessions already running keep the one they started with.
chapter.expects: A Chapter upload holds lessons_list.json, one JSON file per lesson (named after its slug) and slides.pdf, optionally inside one wrapping folder.
chapter.loadFailed: The Content versions could not be loaded

course.title: Course content versions
course.description: The files shared by every Chapter of this Course are uploaded on their own. Each upload is kept as a numbered version; new Sessions use the live one, and Sessions already running keep theirs.
course.expects: A Course upload holds 01_Course_Knowledge_Schema.md and cast.json.
course.loadFailed: The Course content versions could not be loaded

upload.title: Upload a new version
upload.help: Choose a folder or a zip file. A folder is zipped in your browser, then sent straight to the server. The files are checked when they arrive. A version that fails the checks is kept with its report, and cannot go live.
upload.skipped: {count, plural, one {# system file} other {# system files}} left out.
upload.processing: Sent. The server is checking and storing the files.
upload.notZip: That file is not a zip file. Choose a file that ends in .zip, or a folder.
upload.doneValid: Version {version} uploaded. It passed validation and is not live yet.
upload.doneInvalid: Version {version} uploaded, but it failed validation with {count, plural, one {# finding} other {# findings}}. It cannot go live. The report is open below. Fix the files and upload again.

list.title: Versions
list.empty: No versions yet. Upload the first one.
list.count: {count, plural, one {# version} other {# versions}}, newest first

row.previewedBy: Previewed in {count, plural, one {# Admin Session} other {# Admin Sessions}}
row.toggle: Show or hide the details of version {version}

detail.notPreviewedBody: No Admin has had a Session on this version. Preview it in the student app before you set it live.
detail.previewedBody: Previewed in {count, plural, one {# Admin Session} other {# Admin Sessions}}.
detail.reportIntro: This is the content validator's own output, shown as written. Each finding names its rule and where in the file it applies.
detail.reportPassed: The version passed validation. There are no findings.
detail.reportFailed: This version failed validation and cannot go live. {count, plural, one {# finding} other {# findings}} in {files, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}.
detail.reportNone: No validation report: this version was registered in place.
detail.filesNone: Registered in place; no upload record.
detail.factsSessionsValue: {count, plural, one {# Session} other {# Sessions}} used it, {admin} of them Admin Sessions
detail.notPreviewedBodyCourse: No Admin has had a Session on this version yet.

preview.help: Opens the student app in a new tab with an Admin Session on this version. Students are not affected.
preview.unavailable: The preview link is not available because the admin app has no student app address (STUDENT_APP_URL).
preview.invalidOnly: Only a version that passed validation can be previewed.

actions.cannotGoLive: A version that failed validation cannot go live.

deleteBlockers.wasLive: it was live once, and is kept so a rollback can use it.
deleteBlockers.sessions: {count, plural, one {# Session used it.} other {# Sessions used it.}}

live.setDescription: New Sessions will use version {version}. Sessions that are already running keep the version they started with.
live.setFirst: Nothing is live yet, so this becomes the first live version.
live.rollbackDescription: New Sessions will go back to version {version} instead of version {current}. Sessions that are already running keep the version they started with. Version {current} is kept and can be set live again.
live.lessonCount: The Chapter's lesson count becomes {count}, read from this version.
live.chapterState: Setting a version live does not change the Chapter's state.
live.notPreviewed: This version has not been previewed. Consider previewing it in the student app first.

delete.title: Delete version {version}?
delete.description: Its files are removed from storage and the version is gone for good. It was never live and no Session used it.
delete.filesLine: {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} will be removed.
